text: In October 2025, Transportation Staff conducted a study to see if an all-way stop control at the intersection of Glengrove Avenue West and Coldstream Avenue met the criteria required for installation. This study came back finding that the criteria were not met. However, I have recently spoken to many members of the community who are concerned about the impacts of not having an all-way stop control at this intersection on community safety in the neighbourhood. Therefore, I am requesting that all-way stop controls be installed at the intersection of Glengrove Avenue West and Coldstream Avenue.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Glengrove Avenue West and Coldstream Avenue.
